subject: MAP proposal: staged commit & monthly TPM targets for BrightWave evaluation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@brightwave.ai>
Date: 2025-09-08T14:12:00-04:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — evaluation -> commit cadence

Sara — great talking earlier. As discussed, BrightWave is close to deciding on a committed plan but procurement needs a short mutual action plan (MAP) that ties the evaluation milestones to a staged commit and monthly tokens (TPM) ramp.

I put together a very short template idea:
- Week 0–2: PoC (integration + baseline perf) — no commit; Redwood provides evaluation credits (50k tokens).
- Month 1: Initial commit (10k TPM) — 15% discount off list for first 3 months in exchange for a 6-month ramp outline.
- Month 2–3: Ramp to 50k TPM — step increases tied to usage gates and SLA review.
- Month 4+: Full commit 200k TPM (annual) with pricing tiers and overage policy.

Can you confirm: 1) whether procurement needs vendor T&Cs up front, 2) their target monthly TPM for first three months, and 3) preferred closer date for signature? I can attach a one-page MAP and two priced options for legal/finance.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

From: Sara Patel <sara@brightwave.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-09T09:46:00-04:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation -> commit cadence

Jordan — thanks, that framework is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:
- Procurement will want Redwood's standard terms and a short SOW clause that binds the staged commits to the TPM ramp. They typically ask for an overall PO on signature and monthly usage reporting.
- Our initial internal target is 25k TPM in month 1, moving to 75k by month 3, assuming latency and inference quality are acceptable.
- Can you provide two priced alternatives (conservative ramp vs accelerated ramp) + the specific discount tiers for commit thresholds? If possible, show the monthly invoice expectation so our FP&A can plug numbers into the Q4 forecast.

Also note: Tom (cc) will own procurement coordination. We aim to finalize commercial terms by 2025-09-18 if that aligns with Redwood's approval process.

Best,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of AI Products, BrightWave AI

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@brightwave.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightwave.ai>
Date: 2025-09-10T11:05:00-04:00

Sara / Tom — attaching a one-page MAP (BrightWave_MAP_v1.pdf) and an 'estimates' CSV with expected token profiles based on the demo workload. High-level commercial options below — pick which mapping you prefer and I will circulate a formal MAP + signature-ready DocuSign.

Option A — Conservative ramp (lower early commit, smaller discount)
- Month 1: 25k TPM (commit) — $0.0020/token equivalent; no upfront; 5% discount off list for months 1–3
- Month 2: 50k TPM; Month 3: 75k TPM
- Full annual commit target after month 4: 150k TPM
- Redwood provides 75k evaluation credits for PoC

Option B — Accelerated ramp (larger early commit, improved pricing)
- Month 1: 50k TPM (commit) — $0.0018/token equivalent; 15% discount months 1–3
- Month 2: 100k TPM; Month 3: 150k TPM
- Full annual commit target after month 4: 300k TPM
- Redwood provides 150k evaluation credits for PoC

Notes/terms: pricing above reflects token unit economics and includes standard support. We can add an SLA credit clause for latency regressions and automated fallback to a lower-cost variant if peak capacity is constrained. Legal will need to review Redwood_SA-Term_2026.docx (I can share on request).

Next steps I propose: 1) You choose A or B (or hybrid), 2) we lock a signature target (you suggested 2025-09-18), 3) procurement sends PO and we activate Dedicated/testing capacity.

Attaching: BrightWave_MAP_v1.pdf; usage_estimates_brightwave.csv

Regards,
Jordan

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Date: 2025-09-11T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: FW: MAP kickoff — need pricing/discount sign-off

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding the thread. BrightWave prefers Option B if we can give a concession on months 1–3 pricing (Sara asked for 15% which I priced in Option B). Procurement also wants vendor T&Cs and an invoice schedule that maps to monthly TPM.

Two quick asks:
1) Revenue / Finance: Is 15% off list for months 1–3 acceptable if they commit to the accelerated ramp to 300k TPM annual target? What minimum ARR/commit do we need to protect margin?
2) Pricing Ops: can we offer a one-time onboarding credit (25% of month 1 invoice) instead of increasing the discount further?

I recommend we keep the MAP timebox (signature by 2025-09-18). If we need legal redlines, let's identify them now — I can offer a 90-day SLA review window rather than changing core T&Cs.

Jordan

Jordan / team — quick technical check on the usage profile attached: the CSV shows a spike pattern (batch queries at peak hours) and long tail conversational retention that will increase KV cache memory. For Option B (accelerated ramp) we should verify two things before promising 300k TPM annual commit:
- Can BrightWave tolerate 95th percentile latencies up to 200ms for heavy prompt variants? If not, we should advise a slightly lower initial TPM or add dedicated concurrency guarantees.
- If they intend to use streaming responses extensively, token counts will be ~1.6x higher than our conservative estimate; that impacts the invoiced tokens in months 2–3.

Recommendation: present Option B with a usage cap clause and an automated review at 60 days that will allow a minor price adjustment if actual tokens exceed estimates by >20%. Also propose Redwood provides one week of Dedicated capacity warm-up at no charge to validate perf (we can allocate during Sept).

Diego
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Patel <sara@brightwave.ai>

Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightwave.ai>, procurement@brightwave.ai
Date: 2025-09-15T09:03:00-04:00

Jordan / team — thanks for the rapid follow-ups and the MAP doc. We reviewed Option B internally and are prepared to move forward with the accelerated ramp subject to two items: 1) a 15% discount months 1–3 (as outlined), and 2) the usage-cap review at 60 days (Diego's suggestion) written into the MAP. Procurement will issue a PO contingent on a signed MAP + Redwood's standard terms.

We also request a one-time onboarding credit equal to 25% of month 1 invoice to offset integration costs — if you can include that as a separate line item (rather than increasing the recurring discount), procurement will be comfortable approving the PO.

Target: signature and PO in the week of 2025-09-15, contract effective 2025-10-01. Please send the DocuSign link and final MAP + SA-term bundle.

Thanks,
Sara
